tool.upi.title: UPI / BHIM — Digital Payments
tool.upi.short: Send and receive money directly from your phone — no card machine needed.
tool.upi.why: Accept payments from customers without handling cash. A QR code at your shop lets any customer pay you from their phone in seconds.
tool.upi.setup: 1. Download your bank's app or the BHIM app. 2. Link your mobile number and bank account. 3. Set a 4 or 6-digit UPI PIN. 4. Display a QR code at your shop.
tool.upi.tip: Never share your UPI PIN with anyone. Bank staff will never ask for it.
tool.digilocker.title: DigiLocker — Digital Document Storage
tool.digilocker.short: Store government-verified copies of your documents on your phone.
tool.digilocker.why: Never lose originals again. Show Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence, or certificates from your phone at any government office — they are legally valid.
tool.digilocker.setup: 1. Download the DigiLocker app. 2. Register with your mobile number and Aadhaar. 3. Link the documents you use most. 4. Access them offline anytime.
tool.digilocker.tip: DigiLocker documents are legally accepted across India — same as originals.
tool.umang.title: UMANG — Government Services App
tool.umang.short: One app for 200+ central and state government services.
tool.umang.why: Apply for schemes, check application status, pay bills, and access land records — all in one place without visiting offices.
tool.umang.setup: 1. Download UMANG from the Play Store. 2. Register with your mobile number. 3. Select Maharashtra as your state. 4. Switch the app language to Marathi from settings.
tool.umang.tip: Set the app language to Marathi inside UMANG for easier navigation.
tool.udyam.title: Udyam Registration — Business ID
tool.udyam.short: Free government registration for micro, small, and medium businesses.
tool.udyam.why: Required to apply for MSME schemes, subsidies, and priority loans. Also protects you from delayed payments by large buyers.
tool.udyam.setup: 1. Visit udyamregistration.gov.in. 2. Enter your Aadhaar and PAN. 3. Fill in your business details. 4. Download the Udyam certificate instantly.
tool.udyam.tip: Registration is 100% free. Do not pay any agent or middleman.
tool.enam.title: e-NAM — Online Agriculture Market
tool.enam.short: Sell your produce to buyers across India, not just local traders.
tool.enam.why: Get better prices by comparing mandi rates across the state before selling. Reduce dependence on local middlemen.
tool.enam.setup: 1. Register at enam.gov.in with Aadhaar, mobile, and bank details. 2. Visit your local mandi to complete verification. 3. Start bidding or accepting offers online.
tool.enam.tip: Check daily e-NAM prices before selling in your local mandi to negotiate better.
tool.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business — Customer Contact
tool.whatsapp.short: Free business version of WhatsApp with product catalog and auto-replies.
tool.whatsapp.why: Show product photos, receive orders, and reply to customers professionally. Build a customer list you can reach anytime.
tool.whatsapp.setup: 1. Download WhatsApp Business. 2. Create your business profile with address and hours. 3. Add product photos and prices to the catalog. 4. Set an away message for busy hours.
tool.whatsapp.tip: Set an away message so customers know when you will reply, even when you are busy.

scheme.pmegp.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
scheme.pmegp.short: Credit-linked subsidy for new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors.
scheme.pmegp.eligibility: Any individual above 18 years. For projects above ₹5 lakh, at least 8th standard pass is required.
scheme.pmegp.benefit: Manufacturing: project cost up to ₹50 lakh. Service: up to ₹20 lakh. Subsidy: 15–25% for general category, 25–35% for special category (SC/ST/OBC/women/minorities).
scheme.pmegp.documents: Aadhaar, PAN, passport photos, educational certificates, caste/community certificate, rural area certificate, project report.
scheme.pmegp.step2: Register as a new user with Aadhaar and mobile
scheme.pmegp.step3: Choose the scheme and fill the online application
scheme.pmegp.step4: Upload required documents and project report
scheme.pmegp.step5: Submit to KVIC/KVIB and get your application ID
scheme.pmegp.step6: Attend interview at the task force committee
scheme.annasaheb.title: Annasaheb Patil Arthik Vikas Mahamandal
scheme.annasaheb.short: Interest subsidy on business loans for Maratha community entrepreneurs.
scheme.annasaheb.eligibility: Maratha community individuals from Maharashtra. Loan amount up to ₹15 lakh.
scheme.annasaheb.benefit: Interest subsidy on loans up to ₹15 lakh for starting a business.
scheme.annasaheb.documents: Aadhaar, caste certificate, income certificate, project report, bank details.
scheme.lakhpati.title: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
scheme.lakhpati.short: Support for rural women to earn ₹1 lakh annually through sustainable livelihood activities.
scheme.lakhpati.eligibility: Women from rural Maharashtra who are members of Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
scheme.lakhpati.benefit: Access to enterprise financing, skill development, digital literacy, working capital, digital payment setup, structured market linkages and mentorship.
scheme.lakhpati.documents: SHG membership proof, Aadhaar, bank account details, project proposal.
scheme.miips.title: Maharashtra Industries, Investment and Services Policy 2025 (MIIPS)
scheme.miips.short: Comprehensive MSME incentives including interest subsidy, SGST refund, stamp duty exemption.
scheme.miips.eligibility: Eligible MSMEs as classified under MSMED Act, 2006. Benefits vary by taluka classification and Fixed Capital Investment.
scheme.miips.benefit: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (100% SGST refund), interest subsidy up to 5% p.a. (max ₹1 crore/year), stamp duty exemption, electricity duty exemption, employment-linked subsidy, PLI for export-oriented units.
scheme.miips.documents: MSME registration (Udyam), GST registration, project report, investment details, bank statements.
scheme.nssc.title: National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH)
scheme.nssc.short: Promotes entrepreneurship among SC/ST communities and facilitates 4% procurement from SC/ST MSEs.
scheme.nssc.eligibility: SC/ST entrepreneurs with micro or small enterprises.
scheme.nssc.benefit: Support for entrepreneurship, facilitation of 4% procurement from SC/ST MSEs under Public Procurement Policy.
scheme.nssc.documents: Caste certificate, Udyam registration, business plan, bank details.
scheme.pmmy.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
scheme.pmmy.short: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for micro and small enterprises.
scheme.pmmy.eligibility: Non-corporate micro/small enterprises engaged in non-farm income-generating activities.
scheme.pmmy.benefit: Loans under Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (up to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (up to ₹10 lakh) categories.
scheme.pmmy.documents: Aadhaar, PAN, business plan, bank details, address proof.
scheme.pmmy.apply: Apply on mudra.org.in or visit your nearest bank
scheme.pmmy.step1: Visit mudra.org.in or your nearest bank
scheme.pmmy.step2: Fill the Mudra loan application form
scheme.pmmy.step3: Submit business plan and KYC documents
scheme.pmmy.step5: Receive loan amount in your account
scheme.standup.title: Stand-Up India Scheme
scheme.standup.short: Loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises.
scheme.standup.eligibility: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs above 18 years.
scheme.standup.benefit: Composite loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises.
scheme.standup.documents: Aadhaar, PAN, caste certificate (for SC/ST), project report, bank details.
scheme.cgtmse.title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
scheme.cgtmse.short: Collateral-free and third-party guarantee-free loans for MSMEs.
scheme.cgtmse.benefit: Guarantee cover for loans up to ₹5 crore, enabling collateral-free and third-party guarantee-free credit.
scheme.cgtmse.documents: Udyam registration, Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, business plan.
scheme.cgtmse.apply: Contact your bank or visit cgtmse.in
scheme.psb59.title: PSB Loans in 59 Minutes
scheme.psb59.short: MSME loan approval in principle within 59 minutes.
scheme.psb59.benefit: In-principle approval for loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹5 crore within 59 minutes.
scheme.psb59.documents: GST returns, ITR, bank statements, Aadhaar, PAN.
scheme.udyam.title: Udyam Registration
scheme.udyam.short: Free government registration for micro, small, and medium businesses.
scheme.udyam.benefit: Official business identity for MSME schemes, subsidies, priority loans, and protection against delayed payments.
scheme.pmfme.title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
scheme.pmfme.short: Up to 35% subsidy and credit for food processing units.
scheme.pmfme.eligibility: Existing and new micro food processing enterprises.
scheme.pmfme.benefit: Credit-linked subsidy up to 35% of project cost (max ₹10 lakh), branding and marketing support.
scheme.pmfme.documents: Aadhaar, PAN, project report, bank details, Udyam registration.
scheme.seedfund.title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
scheme.seedfund.eligibility: DPIIT-recognized startups less than 2 years old.
scheme.seedfund.benefit: Grants up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept/prototype, up to ₹50 lakh for product trials/market entry.
scheme.seedfund.documents: Startup registration, Aadhaar, PAN, business plan.
scheme.msins.title: Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSINS)
scheme.msins.short: Funding, mentorship, and incubation support for startups in Maharashtra.
scheme.msins.benefit: Seed funding, mentorship, incubation support, networking opportunities.
scheme.msins.documents: Startup registration, Aadhaar, PAN, business plan.
scheme.vishwakarma.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
scheme.vishwakarma.short: Skill training and loans up to ₹3 lakh for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
scheme.vishwakarma.eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades (blacksmith, carpenter, tailor, potter, etc.).
scheme.vishwakarma.benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, skill training, collateral-free credit at 5% interest — ₹1 lakh (first) and ₹2 lakh (second).
scheme.vishwakarma.documents: Aadhaar, bank details, proof of trade.
scheme.svanidhi.title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
scheme.svanidhi.short: Working capital loans from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 for street vendors.
scheme.svanidhi.eligibility: Street vendors in urban areas who were vending on or before 24 March 2020.
scheme.svanidhi.benefit: First loan ₹10,000, second ₹20,000, third ₹50,000 — with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.
scheme.svanidhi.documents: Certificate of Vending or LOI, Aadhaar, bank details.
scheme.nskfdc.title: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
scheme.nskfdc.short: Low-interest self-employment loans for the Scheduled Caste community.
scheme.nskfdc.eligibility: Individuals from Scheduled Caste community seeking self-employment.
scheme.nskfdc.benefit: Loans at concessional interest rates for self-employment, education loans.
scheme.nskfdc.documents: Caste certificate, Aadhaar, income certificate, project report.
scheme.nbcfdc.title: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC)
scheme.nbcfdc.short: Financial assistance for OBC and other backward classes.
scheme.nbcfdc.benefit: Low-interest loans for education, business, and self-employment.
scheme.nbcfdc.documents: OBC certificate, Aadhaar, income certificate, project report.
scheme.nmdfc.title: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
scheme.nmdfc.short: Low-interest loans and assistance for minority communities.
scheme.nmdfc.benefit: Low-interest loans for education, business, and self-employment.
scheme.nmdfc.documents: Minority certificate, Aadhaar, income certificate, project report.
